- Name: tw-framework

- Description: TW framework CLI with create, dev, build, and deploy commands
- Requires-Python: >=3.9
- Dependencies: []
- Optional dependencies: dev = ["pytest>=7"]

## package.json

- Name: twlang-main
- Private: true
- Version: 0.8.44
- Engines: node >= 18

## Project Structure

- Project root marker: tw.config file
- Source folder: [home]/ (literal brackets — App Router root)
- Components: [home]/components/*.tw
- Layouts: [home]/layout.tw
- Pages: [home]/page.tw, [home]/about/page.tw, etc.
- Dynamic routes: [home]/blog/[slug]/page.tw
- API routes: [home]/api/*/route.tw
- Libraries: [home]/lib/*.js
- Styles: [home]/style.tss
- Static files: public/ (served as-is)
- Build output: dist/

## File Extensions

- .tw — pages, components, layouts (TW markup)
- .tss — stylesheets (TW Style System)
- .twm — API routes, server-side modules (TW Module)
- .js/.ts — client-side libraries
- .json — data files for dynamic routes

## CLI Commands

- tw create <name> — create new project
- tw dev — start dev server (127.0.0.1:3000)
- tw build — build to dist/
- tw serve — production SSR server
- tw preview — preview built site
- tw install <pkg> — install npm package
- tw clean — clear cache
- tw doctor — health check
- tw info — project info
- tw export — export static site
- tw deploy — deploy

## tw.config Options

- name: site name
- site_url: base URL (required for sitemap/RSS)
- description: site description
- theme: system | light | dark
- pretty_urls: true/false
- search: true/false
- modular_pipeline: true/false
- allow_raw_script: true/false
- sitemap: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- robots: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- rss: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- auto_image_alt: true/false (default false — opt-in)

## Render Modes

- render static — SSG, build-time HTML (default)
- render server — SSR, per-request server render
- render edge — edge runtime
- render interactive — React client-side hydration
- render dynamic — auto-detect based on page content

## Import Syntax

- import "Navbar" — component import from [home]/components/ (OPTIONAL — auto-discovery works)
- import { fn } from "@/lib/file" — ES6 library import from [home]/lib/
- load "@/data.json" — JSON data load
- load "@/style.tss" — stylesheet load
- load "@/lib/auth" — .twm module load

## Component System

- Components in [home]/components/ are **auto-discovered** — no import needed
- File name = component name: Button.tw → use as `Button {}`
- Props via `let` keyword in component file
- `import "Button"` also works but is optional
- Scoped CSS: ComponentName.tss auto-scoped via data-tw-{hash}

## Script Blocks

- Inline: `script { console.log("hello") }` — raw JS
- {prop} interpolation works in scripts (v0.8.47+)
- External: `script { src "@/lib/file.js" }` — @/ resolved, file copied to dist/ (v0.8.47+)
- External URL: `script { src "https://cdn.example.com/lib.js" }`

## Key Features (v0.8.47)

- App Router with nested layouts
- Zero JS by default (static HTML + CSS)
- React compatibility (render interactive)
- NPM package support (tw install)
- esbuild bundling for client-side imports
- Dynamic routes with generateStaticParams
- Image optimization (image tag vs img tag)
- Scoped CSS for components (.tss files)
- Dev server error overlay
- Incremental build with cache
- Opt-in sitemap.xml, robots.txt, rss.xml
- XSL stylesheet for stylish sitemap
- Auto image alt from filename
- Dark/light theme support
- Middleware (auth, headers, rewrites)
- API routes (.twm files)
- WebSocket support
- Code splitting
- Tree shaking
